mapper.select: SELECT t_oilFieldInfo.id, t_oilFieldInfo.t_location, t_oilFieldInfo.t_status, t_oilFieldInfo.t_production, t_oilFieldInfo.t_bz, t_oilFieldInfo.addTime FROM t_oilFieldInfo WHERE t_oilFieldInfo.id = #{id}

SELECT t_oilFieldInfo.id, t_oilFieldInfo.t_location, t_oilFieldInfo.t_status, t_oilFieldInfo.t_production, t_oilFieldInfo.t_bz, t_oilFieldInfo.addTime FROM t_oilFieldInfo WHERE 1 = 1
and t_oilFieldInfo.t_location like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_oilFieldInfo.t_status like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_oilFieldInfo.t_production like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_oilFieldInfo.t_bz like '%${fieldValue}%'
and t_oilFieldInfo.addTime like '%${fieldValue}%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_oilFieldInfo(addTime,t_location, t_status, t_production, t_bz) VALUES(#{addTime},#{location}, #{status}, #{production}, #{bz})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_oilFieldInfo set t_location=#{location}, t_status=#{status}, t_production=#{production}, t_bz=#{bz} where id=#{id}
